items.en: Ukrainian Mirage 2000-5F downs Russian S8000 Banderol cruise missile with its cannon for the first time
items.nl: Oekraïense Mirage 2000-5F schiet voor het eerst Russisch S8000 Banderol-kruisvluchtwapen neer met boordkanon
items.sEn: Ukrainian outlet Militarnyi reported on 2 October that a Ukrainian Air Force Mirage 2000-5F has for the first time shot down a Russian S8000 Banderol small cruise missile with its cannon. items.en: Russia's Dan-T munition blurs line between UAVs, cruise missiles — Rostec claims S-71M, S-71K and Dan-T jet drones form a new drone-missile class
items.nl: Russische Dan-T-munitie doet grens tussen UAV's en kruisraketten vervagen — Rostec presenteert S-71M, S-71K en Dan-T als nieuwe klasse tussen drone en raket
items.sEn: Russian state corporation Rostec, in comments to the Defence Ministry newspaper Krasnaya Zvezda (30 September) and to TASS, claims that three of its newest jet-powered strike drones — the S-71M, S-71K and Dan-T — form a new category between attack drones and cruise missiles.
